description: A daring expedition to the English coasts, rich in monasteries and treasures. Warriors will face Saxon defenses and bring back glory and plunder. Sailing across the North Sea with strategic stopovers.
requirements: Combat experience required. Swimming ability recommended. Personal weapons mandatory. Duration: 3 months.

description: Exploration and colonization of the volcanic lands of Iceland. Mission to establish a new Viking colony with construction of farms and harbors. Virgin territory offering new opportunities.
requirements: Construction and farming skills appreciated. Suitable for all levels. Duration: 6 months.

description: Major campaign to conquer Frankish lands. Objective: establish a permanent kingdom in Normandy. Intense combat expected against Carolingian armies. Great opportunity for land and titles.
requirements: Experienced warriors only. Battle tactics training required. Duration: 12 months.

description: Exploration voyage to the frozen lands of Greenland. Discovery of new trade routes and establishment of trading posts. Navigation through dangerous waters with icebergs. For the most adventurous.
requirements: Extreme cold resistance. Recommended age: 18 and older. Duration: 4 months.

description: Expedition to the Irish monasteries famous for their gold and manuscript riches. Green islands offering a favorable climate. Quick strikes and return with significant plunder.
requirements: All levels accepted. Training provided. Duration: 2 months.

description: Epic voyage to Byzantium via the rivers of Russia. Trade in furs and amber with the Byzantine Empire. Meeting with the Varangian Guard. A long cultural and commercial expedition.
requirements: All ages. Trading experience appreciated. Long duration: 18 months. Interpreting forbidden.

description: Sailing up the Seine to the gates of Paris. Siege of the Frankish city and negotiation of massive tributes. Spectacular action combining river navigation and coordinated assaults.
requirements: All levels. River navigation training provided. Duration: 3 months.

description: Coordinated raids on the Frisian coasts. Adults-only operation with intense combat and bold strategies. Small elite squad for maximum efficiency and plunder per warrior.
requirements: Reserved for ages 21 and older. Duration: 6 weeks. Contains intense violence and brutal language.

description: Legendary expedition to the mysterious lands to the west. First exploration of Vinland (America). Open sea navigation, discovery of wild grapevines and fertile lands. For intrepid explorers.
requirements: All levels. Afternoon departure. Duration: 12 months.

description: Establishment of a Viking kingdom in the Orkney and Hebrides islands. Mix of colonization, raids, and trade. Strategic islands for control of the North Sea. War music and celebrations guaranteed.
